prompt:
A desktop website homepage for Rubia Rocha Fotografia, a photographer in Curitiba, edge to edge, crisp readable text, no browser chrome, no device, no desk. Warm cream ground #f6f1eb. Top navigation: handwritten script logo “rubia rocha”, links Home, Quem sou, Ensaios, Eventos, Blog, Contato, with only Home in a blush pill #f3e4dc.

What leads is one real job told as a contact strip, not a logo hero. A horizontal row of four wedding photographs from a small civil ceremony: a couple in light clothes, a registry moment, an outdoor portrait, a close portrait. Above the strip, a small tracked sans date “16 mai 2026” and a serif caption “O casamento civil de Shante e Denise no cartório do Portão.” The strip is the largest thing on the screen.

Under the strip, four text rows separated by thin rules, with no thumbnails: Mini casamentos, Festa infantil, Ensaio de gestante, Ensaio de casal. Then one outline pill button “Quero um orçamento”.

Serif for the caption and the row names, plain sans for the date, nav, and button. No card grid, no black background, no shadows, no third-party brand colors. The visitor understands this is one photographed wedding, then sees the other kinds of work as a list.
